mapper.sql: select t.trace_id, t.factory_id, t.trace_type, t.parent_type, t.parent_id, t.child_type, t.child_id, t.quantity, t.unit_of_measure, u.unit_name, t.workorder_id, t.card_id, t.vendor_id, t.card_process_id, t.issue_id, t.issue_detail_id, t.feedback_id, t.transaction_id, t.process_id, t.trace_time, t.remark, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, CASE t.parent_type WHEN 'PUR_ORDER' THEN CONCAT('采购单 ', IFNULL(po.order_code, CONCAT('#', t.parent_id)), IFNULL(CONCAT(' · ', po.vendor_name), '')) WHEN 'VENDOR' THEN CONCAT('供应商 ', IFNULL(v_p.vendor_name, CONCAT('#', t.parent_id))) WHEN 'MATERIAL_STOCK' THEN CONCAT(IFNULL(ms_p.item_name,'未知物料'), IFNULL(CONCAT(' · ', ms_p.warehouse_name),'')) WHEN 'CARD' THEN CONCAT('流转卡 ', IFNULL(c_p.card_code, CONCAT('#', t.parent_id))) WHEN 'FEEDBACK' THEN CONCAT('报工 ', IFNULL(fb_p.feedback_code, CONCAT('#', t.parent_id)), IFNULL(CONCAT(' · ', fb_p.process_name),'')) WHEN 'WORKORDER' THEN CONCAT('工单 ', IFNULL(wo_p.workorder_code, CONCAT('#', t.parent_id)), IFNULL(CONCAT(' · ', wo_p.product_name),'')) WHEN 'ROLL' THEN CONCAT('纸卷 ', IFNULL(r_p.roll_code, CONCAT('#', t.parent_id)), IFNULL(CONCAT(' · ', r_p.item_name),'')) WHEN 'OUTSOURCE_ORDER' THEN CONCAT('外协单 ', IFNULL(oo_p.order_code, CONCAT('#', t.parent_id)), IFNULL(CONCAT(' · ', oo_p.vendor_name), '')) WHEN 'NONE' THEN '无' ELSE CONCAT(t.parent_type, ' #', t.parent_id) END AS parent_desc, CASE t.child_type WHEN 'MATERIAL_STOCK' THEN CONCAT(IFNULL(ms_c.item_name,'未知物料'), IFNULL(CONCAT(' · ', ms_c.warehouse_name),'')) WHEN 'CARD' THEN CONCAT('流转卡 ', IFNULL(c_c.card_code, CONCAT('#', t.child_id))) WHEN 'VENDOR' THEN CONCAT('供应商 ', IFNULL(v_c.vendor_name, CONCAT('#', t.child_id))) WHEN 'FEEDBACK' THEN CONCAT('报工 ', IFNULL(fb_c.feedback_code, CONCAT('#', t.child_id)), IFNULL(CONCAT(' · ', fb_c.process_name),'')) WHEN 'WORKORDER' THEN CONCAT('工单 ', IFNULL(wo_c.workorder_code, CONCAT('#', t.child_id)), IFNULL(CONCAT(' · ', wo_c.product_name),'')) WHEN 'ROLL' THEN CONCAT('纸卷 ', IFNULL(r_c.roll_code, CONCAT('#', t.child_id)), IFNULL(CONCAT(' · ', r_c.item_name),'')) WHEN 'OUTSOURCE_ORDER' THEN CONCAT('外协单 ', IFNULL(oo_c.order_code, CONCAT('#', t.child_id)), IFNULL(CONCAT(' · ', oo_c.vendor_name), '')) WHEN 'SALES_OUT' THEN CONCAT('销售单 #', t.child_id) ELSE CONCAT(t.child_type, ' #', t.child_id) END AS child_desc, COALESCE(ms_c.item_name, c_c.item_name, fb_c.item_name, r_c.item_name, ms_p.item_name, c_p.item_name, fb_p.item_name, r_p.item_name) AS item_name_show, COALESCE(ms_c.item_code, c_c.item_code, fb_c.item_code, r_c.item_code, ms_p.item_code, c_p.item_code, fb_p.item_code, r_p.item_code) AS item_code_show, COALESCE(ms_c.batch_code, c_c.batch_code, ms_p.batch_code, c_p.batch_code) AS batch_code_show from qxx_pro_material_trace t left join qxx_md_unit_measure u on u.unit_code = t.unit_of_measure left join qxx_pur_order po on t.parent_type = 'PUR_ORDER' and po.order_id = t.parent_id left join qxx_md_vendor v_p on t.parent_type = 'VENDOR' and v_p.vendor_id = t.parent_id left join qxx_wm_material_stock ms_p on t.parent_type = 'MATERIAL_STOCK' and ms_p.material_stock_id = t.parent_id left join qxx_pro_card c_p on t.parent_type = 'CARD' and c_p.card_id = t.parent_id left join qxx_pro_feedback fb_p on t.parent_type = 'FEEDBACK' and fb_p.record_id = t.parent_id left join qxx_pro_workorder wo_p on t.parent_type = 'WORKORDER' and wo_p.workorder_id = t.parent_id left join qxx_wm_roll_detail r_p on t.parent_type = 'ROLL' and r_p.roll_id = t.parent_id left join qxx_wm_outsource_order oo_p on t.parent_type = 'OUTSOURCE_ORDER' and oo_p.order_id = t.parent_id left join qxx_wm_material_stock ms_c on t.child_type = 'MATERIAL_STOCK' and ms_c.material_stock_id = t.child_id left join qxx_pro_card c_c on t.child_type = 'CARD' and c_c.card_id = t.child_id left join qxx_pro_workorder wo_c on t.child_type = 'WORKORDER' and wo_c.workorder_id = t.child_id left join qxx_md_vendor v_c on t.child_type = 'VENDOR' and v_c.vendor_id = t.child_id left join qxx_pro_feedback fb_c on t.child_type = 'FEEDBACK' and fb_c.record_id = t.child_id left join qxx_wm_roll_detail r_c on t.child_type = 'ROLL' and r_c.roll_id = t.child_id left join qxx_wm_outsource_order oo_c on t.child_type = 'OUTSOURCE_ORDER' and oo_c.order_id = t.child_id
